title: Auto-close intent grammar misses sanctioned closeout commits

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Grammar + fail-closed tripwire commit. evidence_commit_sha and current_pr_head_sha are resolved by CI.

defect.producer_template: chore(lanes): close $ISSUE_ID — lane closed, sync file removed
defect.class: evidence-conflation: an aggregate green that conflates 'nothing to do' with 'the thing this workflow exists to do did not happen'

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Grammar fixed, with matching cases in the harness
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Anchored closeout form added; 12 sanctioned-closeout cases and 7 tripwire cases; 47 passed / 0 failed.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Fail-closed: a no-match on a closeout-signed commit surfaces as a failure
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Validated by execution: a drifted template exits 1 with reason=closeout_signature_unmatched, while sanctioned closeout, deliberate opt-out and ordinary commits all exit 0.
Deliberately sequenced after this fix merges. Replaying while the grammar is still blind would re-emit commits that again match nothing. Baseline recorded in reconcile_baseline.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Three-way agreement proven by a clean ops:orchestration-reconcile run

known_limitations: Exit criteria 2, 3 and 4 (sanctioned replay, three-way agreement, zero ghosts) are NOT satisfied by this bundle. It covers exit criterion 1 and the fail-closed requirement only.

The reconciler emits no sanctioned repair action for ORCH-MERGED-PR-LINEAR-DONE. Its repair_plan contains 3 actions, all for open-PR-without-manifest and closed-branch-cleanup states. The replay path for these 25 rows is therefore a workflow_dispatch re-run of post-merge-lane-close.yml per affected PR, not an ops:manifest-repair invocation.
This lane may not produce its own t1-approved label or pm-verdict/v1 comment.
